title: Evidence record
description: Independently collected proof bound to an artifact version. Agent self-reports are not evidence. The kernel defines base types; domain packages define specialized types that extend one (e.g. software-development/test_result extends check_result). See docs/VERIFICATION.md.

domain_type.description: Optional specialized type '<domain>/<type>' declared by a domain package; must extend 'type'.

artifact_version.description: Immutable version of what was verified, as defined by the domain workspace binding.

collected_by.description: verifier | role id | billy. Must not be the producing run.
